name: send_follow_up_email
description: Schedule the approved visitor, admin, and Insight intake email bundle for backend delivery only after the session closes and the final transcript is available. A direct request to email or send a follow-up is explicit permission; otherwise obtain one short yes. Never ask for, spell, repeat, confirm aloud, infer, or submit an email address through this tool. Call silently with userConfirmed true and, only when it returns email_queued, say the follow-up will be emailed after the session ends. Never claim it was already sent. Do not use for memory access, cold outreach, third-party recipients, or automatic call closing.

userConfirmed.description: Must be true only after the visitor explicitly agrees during this conversation to receive Amy's follow-up email.
